crossRefs.note: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.
“I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria. They prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is…
When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his…
“So you, son of man: I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and give…
When I tell the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ and you don’t speak to warn the wicked from his way; that…
For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak…
As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul…
The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.
Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ…
I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service;
The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men, who will be able…

translations.web: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
translations.bsb: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a faithful envoy brings healing.
translations.kjv: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
translations.asv: A wicked messenger falleth into evil; But a faithful ambassador is health.
